translationRepairs: When Liu Chong of Bingzhou marched south, Tong was sent under Wang Yanchao of Hezhong to intercept him by way of Jinzhou; the force was beaten at Gaoping.
When Liu Chong of Bingzhou marched south, Tong was sent under Wang Yanchao of Hezhong to intercept him by way of Jinzhou; they defeated him at Gaoping.
The clause records Liu Chong's defeat at Gaoping. Reading it as a defeat of Tong and Wang Yanchao reverses the documented result and breaks the object continuity from 擊之.
Liu Chong of Bingzhou invaded southward. Tong was ordered to assist Wang Yanchao of Hezhong in striking him along the Jinzhou route, but they were defeated at Gaoping.
Liu Chong of Bingzhou invaded southward. Tong was ordered to assist Wang Yanchao of Hezhong in striking him along the Jinzhou route, and they defeated him at Gaoping.
The literal field makes the same reversal. Tong and Wang Yanchao were sent to attack Liu Chong, whose forces were defeated at Gaoping.
When Emperor Gong succeeded, Tong was transferred to garrison Yanzhou.
When Emperor Gong succeeded, Tong was transferred to garrison Yunzhou.
The source has 鄆州, Yunzhou. Yanzhou would be 姚州 or 兌州 and names a different prefecture.
When Emperor Gong succeeded, Tong was transferred to garrison Yanzhou.
When Emperor Gong succeeded, Tong was transferred to garrison Yunzhou.
The literal field repeats the same place-name error; 鄆州 must be rendered Yunzhou here.
Murong Yanhao and Wang Quanbin were sent by the eastern route to join Shouxin. With the inspector Li Chongju they routed Yun at Changping and took three thousand heads.
Murong Yanzhao and Wang Quanbin were sent by the eastern route to join Shouxin. With the inspector Li Chongju they routed Yun at Changping and took three thousand heads.
慕容延釗 is Murong Yanzhao. Yanhao is a mistranscription of the final character and is not an attested alternate name.
That evening he feasted his officers with Shoujie present and appointed him training commissioner of Shan;
That day he feasted his officers with Shoujie present and appointed him training commissioner of Shanzhou;
單州 is the prefecture name Shanzhou, so the bare form 'Shan' obscures the territorial command. The revision also restores 是日 as 'that day,' correcting the unsupported 'that evening.'
